faf7bb5b31fdba4c1d25729ea60df057526ddd62.trigger_en: Marked fatigue lasting weeks between cycles
faf7bb5b31fdba4c1d25729ea60df057526ddd62.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse about marked fatigue. Do not automatically assume it is caused by slow bone marrow recovery.

cbeb725a09c76ac2dbdadb6df6762db13a08a45d.trigger_en: Mouth pain or ulcers without the immediate-contact signs listed below
cbeb725a09c76ac2dbdadb6df6762db13a08a45d.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse. Take gentle care of your mouth and choose soft foods. If you cannot eat or drink, have uncontrolled pain or bleeding, or difficulty swallowing, contact your team immediately.

27cf471133f7fde2c1467364cf6adab2cc1b4ad8.trigger_en: Tingling or numbness in the hands or feet
27cf471133f7fde2c1467364cf6adab2cc1b4ad8.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse about tingling or numbness, especially if it interferes with everyday activities.

f8b792eb6289afcafb67a58cdfbd35d98b2f7979.trigger_en: Very severe headache that does not improve after prescribed pain relief
f8b792eb6289afcafb67a58cdfbd35d98b2f7979.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not wait until your next visit, including after intrathecal administration.

518a262be631b00f723f2437be43f5197cacd017.action_en: Go to hospital immediately: deep, prolonged neutropenia carries a risk of sepsis.

56ea6a6512499ddcaf0596bb9ea09f4153b729d0.trigger_en: Unable to eat or drink; uncontrolled pain or bleeding from the mouth; difficulty opening your mouth or swallowing; white patches in the mouth or frequent coughing when eating or drinking
56ea6a6512499ddcaf0596bb9ea09f4153b729d0.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately. If you cannot reach your treatment team, go to the nearest emergency department.

9f01587bb32b91299b991d36061f5ad85ed76227.trigger_en: New confusion, marked drowsiness, dizziness, loss of balance, double vision, hallucinations, seizures, difficulty walking or slow, slurred speech during or shortly after IVAC
9f01587bb32b91299b991d36061f5ad85ed76227.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department. Do not dismiss these symptoms as ordinary fatigue or a reaction to a puncture.

46be051b642f223aa39107096c20af79cca6b512.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse about marked fatigue.

16edc80ce3a3d492adf9c42401b8a374dc82218d.trigger_en: Mouth pain or ulcers without the immediate-contact signs listed below
16edc80ce3a3d492adf9c42401b8a374dc82218d.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse. Choose soft foods and take gentle care of your mouth.

72e8fd3f23fb97628294ac8c52df7ec55b553230.action_en: Take prescribed anti-nausea medicines as instructed by your team. Tell your doctor or nurse about symptoms that worry you.

891e49a6446b3e934f73dc100b77dcb3c51dd2bf.trigger_en: Tingling, numbness or pain in the hands or feet
891e49a6446b3e934f73dc100b77dcb3c51dd2bf.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse, especially if the symptoms interfere with everyday activities.

8425c5eccea81f32d2496cfa424e206469688e0b.trigger_en: A temperature of 38°C or higher; chills, shaking or a sudden deterioration in how you feel, even without a temperature
8425c5eccea81f32d2496cfa424e206469688e0b.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

b93d327eda1975f5967ab72e2a4d480d0dcaf429.trigger_en: New shortness of breath, chest pain or a fast or irregular heartbeat
b93d327eda1975f5967ab72e2a4d480d0dcaf429.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

debe8f7f4d49a4054bd4ef7bf93ac1fc9bad7654.trigger_en: Signs of an allergic reaction during or after an infusion: rash, itching, wheezing or difficulty breathing, chills, dizziness or fainting
debe8f7f4d49a4054bd4ef7bf93ac1fc9bad7654.action_en: During the infusion, tell staff immediately. After leaving the clinic, contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to an emergency department.

b9db6214306c7729e764b6e1557726e6c9fb1f99.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

849c47cf106316cccdd023d646ee84d1fed93c66.trigger_en: Unable to eat or drink; uncontrolled pain or bleeding from the mouth; difficulty opening your mouth or swallowing; white patches in the mouth or frequent coughing when eating or drinking
849c47cf106316cccdd023d646ee84d1fed93c66.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately. If you cannot reach your treatment team, go to the nearest emergency department.

4f8915426a11added86de80972bc7fe6b6c476f3.trigger_en: New problems with speech, vision, balance or coordination; confusion, limb weakness or seizures
4f8915426a11added86de80972bc7fe6b6c476f3.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

a7bfa796d87c0a6333525c4690dbbc815d50399b.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse about marked fatigue.

3b8c1b93c348e41a3d15f65fc428aa6d8c056aed.trigger_en: Mouth pain or ulcers without the immediate-contact signs listed below
3b8c1b93c348e41a3d15f65fc428aa6d8c056aed.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse. Choose soft foods and take gentle care of your mouth.

621df82c8ac211b5a0aa33bbe9f17eb28bd0db59.trigger_en: Tingling, numbness or pain in the hands or feet
621df82c8ac211b5a0aa33bbe9f17eb28bd0db59.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse, especially if the symptoms interfere with everyday activities.

c7cb6e19dbc13bcd4b3373d90097242362f6ec9b.trigger_en: Passing less urine or a change in urine colour
c7cb6e19dbc13bcd4b3373d90097242362f6ec9b.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse as soon as possible. Agree how much to drink with your treatment team.

74e251cfef77b24aaacda9b690e77a4f1ab7895e.trigger_en: A temperature of 38°C or higher; chills, shaking or feeling unwell, even without a temperature
74e251cfef77b24aaacda9b690e77a4f1ab7895e.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

08042745a39531157e7d4bb80bcfb7dd0a990443.trigger_en: New shortness of breath or chest pain
08042745a39531157e7d4bb80bcfb7dd0a990443.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

490156ac7b7a2c08bba9847db2cfc0283574d933.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

8a78b811f8d22463389248d9c44b2057c3b1b146.trigger_en: Very severe headache not relieved by pain medicine
8a78b811f8d22463389248d9c44b2057c3b1b146.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

b4b8f59418db7950a47ede86228667f9207070db.trigger_en: Signs of an allergic reaction during or after an infusion: rash, itching, difficulty breathing, chills, dizziness or fainting
b4b8f59418db7950a47ede86228667f9207070db.action_en: During the infusion, tell staff immediately. After leaving the clinic, contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to an emergency department.

8a577412947d4a6cfb843ccecb453f2fd56a5752.trigger_en: New confusion, drowsiness, loss of balance, double vision, hallucinations, seizures, difficulty walking or slow, slurred speech during or shortly after IVAC
8a577412947d4a6cfb843ccecb453f2fd56a5752.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

263e19a1fa352b9ad29cac14349d823681d9ec1c.trigger_en: Unable to eat or drink; uncontrolled pain or bleeding from the mouth; difficulty opening your mouth or swallowing; white patches in the mouth or frequent coughing when eating or drinking
263e19a1fa352b9ad29cac14349d823681d9ec1c.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately. If you cannot reach your treatment team, go to the nearest emergency department.

da2df2be4dc09b2adb08da2d501c1778620a7001.trigger_en: New problems with speech or vision, confusion, weakness in the arms or legs, loss of balance or seizures, regardless of the day of the cycle
da2df2be4dc09b2adb08da2d501c1778620a7001.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

2dad0e2f91ad917ae17797e052b11a2a4ec05f9c.trigger_en: Passing less urine or a change in urine colour
2dad0e2f91ad917ae17797e052b11a2a4ec05f9c.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse as soon as possible. Agree how much to drink with your treatment team.

196020e57a50fe112a98b844575efec9d81c1138.trigger_en: Sudden marked weakness, an irregular heartbeat or muscle spasms
196020e57a50fe112a98b844575efec9d81c1138.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department. These symptoms need medical assessment and do not by themselves establish a diagnosis of tumour lysis syndrome. Do not limit seeking help to the first days of the first cycle: the syndrome can also occur before treatment.

a72a95aa7f6c8384dcf70bf4691b666e26abb666.trigger_en: Swollen ankles, new shortness of breath, chest pain or tightness, or an irregular heartbeat
a72a95aa7f6c8384dcf70bf4691b666e26abb666.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department. These symptoms also need assessment after treatment has finished.

5d38a37532e534e4dc7fe7bb2b3796989fa95295.trigger_en: Tingling, numbness or pain in the hands or feet
5d38a37532e534e4dc7fe7bb2b3796989fa95295.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse, especially if symptoms affect everyday activities.

bff63146c34c2bd5a79e404c39d9d9fbd324dc8f.trigger_en: Marked fatigue or lack of energy
bff63146c34c2bd5a79e404c39d9d9fbd324dc8f.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse about these symptoms.

d054cdd921e0e890e2fce81e249975d9a62c445b.trigger_en: Nausea without the immediate-contact signs listed below
d054cdd921e0e890e2fce81e249975d9a62c445b.action_en: Take prescribed anti-sickness medicine as directed and tell your team about symptoms.

fe4cf76a6cfdd2d16a874abbe78aebb42a894d98.trigger_en: Temperature 38°C or higher, chills, or feeling unwell even without a temperature
fe4cf76a6cfdd2d16a874abbe78aebb42a894d98.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

ea24724dda75d4b661aa8e48e4208629a3cd9de2.trigger_en: Worsening tingling, numbness or difficulty with everyday activities
ea24724dda75d4b661aa8e48e4208629a3cd9de2.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse; do not change the dose yourself.

e013f47504ba58117109ba9a597be9984e2249bf.trigger_en: New shortness of breath, chest pain, ankle swelling or unusual heartbeat
e013f47504ba58117109ba9a597be9984e2249bf.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department, including after treatment ends.

5058d45ab0fbf39e77597aa9fe873f21ae49026c.trigger_en: Feeling unwell during or shortly after infusion: rash, wheezing or difficulty breathing
5058d45ab0fbf39e77597aa9fe873f21ae49026c.action_en: In the clinic, tell staff immediately. After leaving, contact your team immediately or go to the nearest emergency department.

1f4fc49dbee72b573543b2485b0f2a817b321ea3.trigger_en: Uncontrolled vomiting or diarrhoea, dizziness or feeling faint
1f4fc49dbee72b573543b2485b0f2a817b321ea3.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

e866dcd06a9dcfb7bde5b6bcf4e3c366cddeb55d.trigger_en: New confusion, speech or vision changes, weakness, poor balance or seizures
e866dcd06a9dcfb7bde5b6bcf4e3c366cddeb55d.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department. These symptoms do not establish a diagnosis.

9d09bb60562ec18a450fa0319314b57932a56c38.trigger_en: Painful rash, blisters, or rash with mouth ulcers or difficulty swallowing
9d09bb60562ec18a450fa0319314b57932a56c38.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

268dae36f017969fc6cf3fbc7113d276d707f33c.trigger_en: Very severe headache that does not improve after prescribed pain relief
268dae36f017969fc6cf3fbc7113d276d707f33c.action_en: Contact your doctor or nurse immediately, or go to the nearest emergency department.

5519258859adedb0574aa4dffe8c6a1a9b281e00.trigger_en: Mouth pain, ulcers or difficulty eating or swallowing without the severe skin-reaction signs above
5519258859adedb0574aa4dffe8c6a1a9b281e00.action_en: Tell your doctor or nurse about these symptoms.
